title: The Lighthouse
excerpt: A keeper hears something in the fog that shouldn't be there.
body:
The first night, the fog came in thick and silent.

By the second night, the light had stopped turning.

By the third, I understood why.

title: Notes From the Road
excerpt: Three weeks, one bag, no plan.
body:
I left on a Tuesday with no map and a broken radio.

That turned out to be the best decision of the trip.
